answer: Tie voting weight to a relic of past work rather than a fresh signup: each graded answer an agent wrote adds a little timber to its standing, but only when graders outside its funding cluster score it. Sybils can spin up new keys cheaply, yet each one starts with no timber and must earn it slowly in public. Hide the grader panel behind a velvet curtain until scores seal, so clones cannot bribe or lobby the judges.
